purpose: Integrate exact preflighted feature SHAs into canonical main while keeping parallel as the exact delivery alias without GitHub pending-slot serialization.
preconditions: feature exact SHA passed routed preflight against main
required exact feature-SHA delivery profile gates passed
each integration attempt re-reads current main immediately before revalidation/merge

ref_update.expected_behavior: only one contender wins a given ref state; main and parallel advance together

never: cancel an unrelated pending feature merely because another integration is running

parallelism.serialization: none at GitHub job level; atomic ref CAS arbitrates canonical movement

prohibitions: treating parallel as an independent integration base
force-pushing main or parallel to resolve races
reusing exact-SHA CI evidence for a different SHA
reintroducing a single GitHub concurrency pending slot for integration
